title: Agent access
description: Create separate credentials for agents that work with this mailbox. Each key has its own permissions and can be revoked.
label: Key name
readHint: Read messages and private attachments in this mailbox.
draftHint: Create and edit drafts in this mailbox.
sendHint: Select only for an agent you authorize to send email from this mailbox. Without it, the agent asks for your approval: you get an email and send the draft from the dashboard.
expirationHint: Use your device's local date and time. Leave empty for no expiration.
futureExpiration: Choose an expiration date and time in the future.
error: The action could not be completed. Check the list and try again.
refreshError: The key was created, but the list could not be updated. Save its token before closing.
secretHint: This token is shown only during this opening. Save it securely: it cannot be retrieved after you close or dismiss it.
copyError: The token could not be copied. Select and copy it manually.
emptyBody: Create one key for each agent that needs access to this mailbox.
revokeSuccess: Key revocation confirmed. This credential no longer grants access.
mcpHint: Agents that speak MCP (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and others) can use this mailbox as tools: list, read, draft and, with the send permission, send. The command below already carries this key, so keep it as private as the key.
mcpOther: Other MCP clients: add a Streamable HTTP server at {url} with the header Authorization: Bearer followed by this key.

team.open: Connect an agent to several mailboxes
team.title: Agent with access to several mailboxes
team.description: One credential for the agent to work in the mailboxes you choose. Each request names the mailbox, like "get the code in mailbox X"; when it names none, the default mailbox is used. Every mailbox keeps its own permissions, limits, send approval and activity record.
team.mailboxesHint: Only your active mailboxes are listed.
team.noDefault: None: the agent always names the mailbox
team.emptyBody: Create one so an agent can serve more than one mailbox with the same key.
team.mailboxCount: {count, plural, =0 {no active mailbox} one {# mailbox} other {# mailboxes}}
team.mcpHint: Agents that speak MCP (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and others) use these mailboxes as tools: each tool takes the mailbox address, and mailbox_list_accounts shows which ones are allowed. The command below carries this key; keep it as carefully.
